description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Autocomplete class, which provides methods to retrieve and prepare data for autocomplete HTML input elements, including fetching users and organizations matching a search term.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Autocomplete
classes.description: A Moose-based class extending Catalyst::Model, providing autocomplete data methods for users and organizations.

methods.name: ACCEPT_CONTEXT
methods.description: Sets the schema attribute from the Catalyst context for each request.

methods.name: organizations_users
methods.description: Returns a combined list of users and organizations matching the search term, with type annotations.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns a list of users matching the search term.
